verdict.rationale: Omnara's main interaction model is natural-language conversation with agents. Users can chat through the dashboard or a first-party Slack connector, send corrections mid-task, queue the next task, answer agent questions, and attach files. Agents then act on those instructions through MCP and custom tools. A community user also reports positively on driving Claude Code from a phone through it. Missing for 10: product setup itself (agent config, model providers, roles) is done through YAML, the dashboard, the CLI or the API rather than by natural-language command, and there is no in-depth documentation or independent hands-on detail on the conversational control surface.
